# install in the home directory as agnthub 0.4.7 did: seen from another HOME, the home directory is a plain project
$ cd /agnthub-e2e/home && HOME=/agnthub-e2e/scratch/other-home XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/agnthub-e2e/home/.config XDG_STATE_HOME=/agnthub-e2e/home/.local/state agnthub add /agnthub-e2e/src/companion --agent companion --harness codex --yes
exit status: 0
--- stdout
Installed · project scope · from /agnthub-e2e/src/companion
  Harnesses
    codex     Codex               detected
  Agents
    companion
      + create       codex     generated  /agnthub-e2e/home/.codex/agents/companion.toml
          project
  1 create
$ cd /agnthub-e2e/home && agnthub list --json
exit status: 0
--- stdout

    "agent": "companion",

    "artifacts": [
      {
        "harness": "codex",
        "variant": "generated",
        "path": "/agnthub-e2e/home/.codex/agents/companion.toml",

          {}
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
]
--- stderr
note: /agnthub-e2e/home/agnthub-lock.json records project-scope installations in your home directory, which earlier agnthub versions wrote there. Harnesses apply them to some projects below it or read them as user configuration; remove them with `agnthub remove` in this directory and reinstall with --global.
$ cd /agnthub-e2e/home && agnthub remove companion --yes --json
exit status: 0
--- stderr
note: /agnthub-e2e/home/agnthub-lock.json records project-scope installations in your home directory, which earlier agnthub versions wrote there. Harnesses apply them to some projects below it or read them as user configuration; remove them with `agnthub remove` in this directory and reinstall with --global.
